counting_unit: Selected evaluation resource or protocol, including explicitly scoped comparisons; not a count of dedicated multimodal-memory benchmark papers.
inclusion_rule: Include dedicated memory tests and broader evaluations used to assess retention, access, maintenance or reuse of multimodal experience. A lack of isolated memory scoring is not an exclusion criterion. Retained text-only or semantic-state comparisons are explicitly identified and are not evidence of native sensory retention.
review_limit: Prior scope review retained for other entries. On 2026-09-17, all six flagged arXiv PDFs were read and Table 2 assignments/descriptors reviewed. VoiceMem still defers annotation detail. MOSAIC was removed at user request because full text was unavailable.

locomo_annotations.rationale: CE is partial because original QA uses captions; LE is directly scored; evolving life events give partial SC rather than a controlled update test; adversarial questions directly test UQ. No dedicated conflict-resolution, action, fine-detail, identity-tracking or visual-state-change score is inferred.

records.name: MMDU
records.title: MMDU: A Multi-Turn Multi-Image Dialog Understanding Benchmark and Instruction-Tuning Dataset for LVLMs
records.rationale: General multi-image, multi-turn dialogue understanding is scored for six broad response-quality dimensions. The protocol does not separately test retention, revision, or later reuse of experience.

records.name: MMRC
records.title: MMRC: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Understanding Multimodal Large Language Model in Real-World Conversation
records.caveat: Memory-related ability tracks; other MMRC tasks are broader dialogue tests.
records.rationale: History-conditioned probes explicitly test memory recall, image management and information updates, alongside cross-turn reasoning. The former dagger is not justified.

records.name: Memory-QA
records.title: Memory-QA: Answering Recall Questions Based on Multimodal Memories
records.rationale: Queries recall visual details from previously saved multimodal records; retrieval uses stored images and temporal/location context.

records.name: LCMP
records.title: TAMEing Long Contexts in Personalization: Towards Training-Free and State-Aware MLLM Personalized Assistant
records.rationale: Personalized visual concepts acquire changing short- and long-term attributes through historical dialogues. Later VQA probes test attribute retention and temporal validity.

records.name: DISBench
records.title: DeepImageSearch: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Context-Aware Image Retrieval in Visual Histories
records.caveat: A fixed-history access benchmark; it does not isolate adaptive memory management.
records.rationale: Context-dependent image retrieval must connect clues across a user's chronological visual archive; individual image matching is insufficient.

records.name: MMA-Bench
records.title: MMA: Multimodal Memory Agent
records.caveat: Use Vision mode; oracle-caption mode alone is text-only.
records.rationale: Ten-session multimodal histories manipulate source reliability, conflicting text/image evidence and resolution, then probe belief revision and justified abstention.

records.name: Mem-Gallery
records.title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents
records.rationale: Memory accumulates across multimodal dialogue sessions and is tested for factual and visual recall, temporal reasoning, updates and inconsistent or insufficient evidence.

records.name: EMemBench
records.title: EMemBench: Interactive Benchmarking of Episodic Memory for VLM Agents
records.rationale: Agent trajectories supply the earlier observations; later programmatically generated questions test recall from those trajectories.
records.caveat: The Crafter setting uses visual observations; Jericho is text-only and should not be treated as a multimodal result.

records.name: ATM-Bench
records.title: According to Me: Long-Term Personalized Referential Memory QA
records.rationale: Personal-memory queries require retrieval from a multi-year multimodal archive, with evidence annotations, multi-source composition and changes over time.

records.name: Persona-MME
records.title: PersonaVLM: Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs
records.caveat: The memory-related multimodal cases support inclusion; personality alignment alone does not diagnose memory.
records.rationale: Longitudinal multimodal dialogues contain changing user attributes; held-out questions explicitly probe personalized memory and history-dependent understanding.

records.name: MemEye
records.title: MemEye: A Visual-Centric Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Agent Memory
records.rationale: Mirrored questions require retained visual details at different granularities and reasoning about the valid state of evolving visual evidence.

records.name: MemLens
records.title: MemLens: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Memory in Large Vision-Language Models
records.rationale: Multimodal evidence sessions are embedded in timestamped histories; tests cover visual recall, multi-session reasoning, updates and evidence removal.

records.name: SMMBench
records.title: SMMBench: A Benchmark for Source-Distributed Multimodal Agent Memory
records.rationale: Sources are ingested in temporal order before the query; retrieval is tested against distributed multimodal evidence, including conflicting records and function-call decisions.

records.name: VisualMem
records.title: Personal Visual Memory from Explicit and Implicit Evidence
records.rationale: Later queries test recurring visual-entity identity and implicit personal facts conveyed by earlier images but absent from conversational text.

records.name: CamRoll
records.title: Personal AI Agent for Camera Roll VQA
records.rationale: Personal-photo histories support episodic and semantic recall questions grounded in the owner's earlier experiences.
records.caveat: An archive-retrieval score does not isolate memory updating.

records.name: RefMem-Bench
records.title: Connecting the Dots: Benchmarking Reflective Memory in Long-Horizon Dialogue
records.caveat: Include the image-grounded branch; text-only tasks do not establish multimodal coverage.
records.rationale: Long-horizon dialogue and speaker-level image histories support reflective-memory questions; answer accuracy and evidence-memory recall are evaluated.

records.name: M$^3$Exam
records.title: M3Exam: Benchmarking Multimodal Memory for Realistic User-Agent Interactions
records.rationale: Multi-session user-agent histories include images and documents; questions have supporting-fact rounds and test memory retrieval, cross-session reasoning and file management.

records.name: H2HMem
records.title: H2HMem: A Multimodal Memory Benchmark for Agents in Human-Human Interactions
records.caveat: The requested repository family is retained for consistency. This source evaluates text/image conversations, not acoustic memory.
records.rationale: Timestamped multimodal human-human sessions are converted into memory before subsequent retrieval and QA; prior interactions supply the required evidence.

records.name: M2CA-Bench
records.title: Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Generation, and Editing
records.rationale: Held-out multimodal dialogues evaluate memory-image selection and the faithfulness of responses using retrieved images.
records.caveat: The reported selection protocol is distinct from general response quality.

records.name: VStream-QA
records.title: Flash-VStream: Memory-Based Real-Time Understanding for Long Video Streams
records.caveat: Limit this row to the real-time historical-evidence protocol; offline full-video QA is less diagnostic.
records.rationale: The real-time VStream-QA protocol processes past video before timestamped questions and tests recall of prior events and their order.

records.name: StreamingBench
records.title: StreamingBench: Assessing the Gap for MLLMs to Achieve Streaming Video Understanding
records.caveat: Limit the row to SQA; current-frame and generic perception tasks do not establish memory coverage.
records.rationale: Sequential Question Answering requires links to entities or events from previous question-answer turns; this is an explicit episodic-history test.

records.name: StreamBench
records.title: Streaming Video Understanding and Multi-round Interaction with Memory-enhanced Knowledge
records.caveat: Limit coverage to memory-search and conversation-history tasks.
records.rationale: Explicit short-term and long-term memory-search tasks introduce query delays; multi-round conversation tasks require earlier interaction records.

records.name: EgoLifeQA
records.title: EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant
records.rationale: Questions about a wearer's life require evidence from at least five minutes earlier, with look-back spans and audio requirements annotated.

records.name: HippoVlog
records.title: HippoMM: Hippocampal-inspired Multimodal Memory for Long Audiovisual Event Understanding
records.caveat: Fixed-recording memory access; end-task QA does not isolate memory management.
records.rationale: The benchmark instantiates memory formation, query-driven retrieval and answer synthesis over audiovisual episodes, with timestamped visual, auditory and cross-modal recall questions.

records.name: M3-Bench
records.title: Seeing, Listening, Remembering, and Reasoning: A Multimodal Agent with Long-Term Memory
records.rationale: Videos simulate agent perceptual experience; future questions reference earlier events and test recall plus reasoning over long-term memory.

records.name: TeleEgo
records.title: TeleEgo: Benchmarking Egocentric AI Assistants in the Wild
records.caveat: Memory and cross-memory tasks support inclusion; ordinary perception/comprehension tasks are not memory evidence.
records.rationale: Multi-day egocentric streams include explicit short-, long- and ultra-long recall and cross-memory reasoning under an online protocol.

records.name: ELViM
records.title: video-SALMONN S: Memory-Enhanced Streaming Audio-Visual LLM
records.rationale: Procedural video evidence is followed by distractors and later next-action questions, testing retention and reuse of earlier demonstrations.
records.caveat: The benchmark appears in v2; v1 should not be used as its protocol reference.

records.name: EgoMem (VideoLucy)
records.title: VideoLucy: Deep Memory Backtracking for Long Video Understanding
records.rationale: Questions over extended egocentric recordings require recalling and locating past events across a long visual history.
records.caveat: Some questions concern local details; the full score is not solely a test of memory management.

records.name: RIVER Bench
records.title: RIVER: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Video LLMs
records.rationale: Retro-Memory questions target previously observed events with temporal gaps.
records.caveat: Live perception and proactive-response tasks introduce additional capabilities.

records.name: MA-EgoQA
records.title: MA-EgoQA: Question Answering over Egocentric Videos from Multiple Embodied Agents
records.rationale: Questions combine earlier observations from multiple agents and timestamps in synchronized egocentric histories.
records.caveat: Access and evidence fusion are tested more directly than policy adaptation.

records.name: LVOmniBench
records.title: LVOmniBench: Pioneering Long Audio-Video Understanding Evaluation for Omnimodal LLMs
records.rationale: Full-recording audio-video QA targets perception, understanding, inference and logical reasoning. Long inputs and temporal reasoning do not by themselves define an agent-memory evaluation.

records.name: MM-Lifelong
records.title: Towards Multimodal Lifelong Understanding: A Dataset and Agentic Baseline
records.rationale: Queries locate and combine relevant evidence within extended lifelogs, with source-interval grounding.
records.caveat: Long-history access does not itself establish memory maintenance or policy evolution.

records.name: EgoMemReason
records.title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding
records.rationale: Entity states, event relations and behavioral patterns must be recovered from week-scale egocentric histories.
records.caveat: End-task reasoning remains coupled to evidence retrieval.

records.name: EgoExoMem
records.title: EgoExoMem: Cross-View Memory Reasoning over Synchronized Egocentric and Exocentric Videos
records.rationale: Historical locations, habits and spatial relations are queried across paired egocentric and exocentric views.
records.caveat: Paired-view retrieval is distinct from autonomous long-term memory-policy adaptation.

records.name: M$^3$Eval
records.title: M$^3$Eval: Multi-Modal Memory Evaluation through Cognitively-Grounded Video Tasks
records.rationale: Controlled sequence construction tests interference, delayed recall and false-memory behavior.
records.caveat: Its diagnostic manipulations should not be generalized to every deployment setting.

records.name: SuperMemory-VQA
records.title: SuperMemory-VQA: An Egocentric Visual Question-Answering Benchmark for Long-Horizon Memory
records.rationale: Personal-history questions target prior object locations, timelines, corrections and intentions.
records.caveat: Overall QA performance also depends on perception and reasoning.

records.name: LongSpace-Bench
records.title: LongSpace: Exploring Long-Horizon Spatial Memory from Perception to Recall in Video
records.rationale: Spatial-memory tasks test appearance order, changing states, route recall and planning over room-tour videos.
records.caveat: Scene perception and spatial-relation tasks also contribute to the full benchmark.

records.name: StreamMemBench
records.title: StreamMemBench: Streaming Evaluation of Agent Memory for Future-Oriented Assistance
records.rationale: A sequence of observation, initial evidence use, feedback and subsequent reuse tests how retained experience supports a later task.
records.caveat: Reusing feedback is not sufficient evidence that a reusable management policy evolves.

records.name: S-EMBER
records.title: S-EMBER: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Streaming Egocentric Memory Retrieval
records.rationale: Causal look-back questions require past visual evidence that is unavailable in the current frame, with supporting temporal intervals.
records.caveat: The evaluated stream is visual; do not infer acoustic retention.

records.name: SLVMBench
records.title: SLVMBench: Skill Learning from Video Memory
records.rationale: Earlier instructional video must support later questions in another stream after distractors and a temporal gap.
records.caveat: Procedural transfer remains coupled to understanding the later scene.

records.name: StreamArena
records.title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
records.rationale: Timestamped, causally available histories support retrospective questions and ongoing interaction.
records.caveat: Proactive response and live perception are broader than historical recall.

records.name: EgoMonth
records.title: EgoMonth: A Month-Level Egocentric Video Benchmark for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Memory
records.rationale: Questions require indexing and combining episodic evidence across month-scale egocentric experience.
records.caveat: Archive QA does not independently measure each memory-lifecycle stage.

records.name: ChatMem-Bench
records.title: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
records.rationale: Long-horizon voice-memory evaluation directly covers updates, abstention, speaker association and acoustic retention.
records.caveat: The full PDF was inspected, but detailed annotation methods are deferred. Contradictions occur in the generation pipeline; conflict resolution and persistent spoken repair are only indirectly supported. No retrieval-ground-truth or executed-action scoring is established.

records.name: PlanRAG-Audio
records.title: PlanRAG-Audio: Planning and Retrieval Augmented Generation for Long-form Audio Understanding
records.rationale: Constructed long-audio QA evaluates perception, counting, temporal and compositional reasoning over recordings. The proposed retrieval agent is a method; its evaluation is not a distinct agent-memory retention or lifecycle benchmark.

records.name: LongAudioQA
records.title: Don't Just Listen, Try Planning: Graph-based Retrieval-Generation Agent for Long-form Audio Meeting Understanding
records.rationale: Meeting QA tests factual, inferential, temporal, summarization and acoustic-aware understanding of provided recordings. It does not introduce a distinct retained-experience or memory-state evaluation.

records.name: ChronosAudio
records.title: ChronosAudio: A Comprehensive Long-Audio Benchmark for Evaluating Audio-Large Language Models
records.rationale: Audio tasks test transcription, localization, comprehension and summarization across input lengths. They do not specifically evaluate agent-memory retention or later reuse.

records.name: AudioMarathon
records.title: AudioMarathon: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Long-Context Audio Understanding and Efficiency in Audio LLMs
records.rationale: Long-audio understanding and reasoning are the evaluation targets; memory-efficient model processing is not itself a benchmark of persistent agent memory.

records.name: Agentic ASR evaluation
records.title: Towards Human-Like Interactive Speech Recognition With Agentic Correction and Semantic Evaluation
records.rationale: Each episode iteratively corrects one speech transcription until semantic equivalence or a round limit. It tests interactive ASR repair, not persistence and later use of corrected agent memory.

records.name: Stateful streaming ASR
records.title: Beyond Fresh Starts: Stateful Inference for Streaming ASR in Conversational Voice Agents
records.rationale: Cache carryover and rollback are assessed through ASR accuracy on conversational speech. This is a speech-component state protocol rather than an agent-memory benchmark.

records.name: EgoMem evaluation
records.title: EgoMem: Lifelong Memory Agent for Full-duplex Omnimodal Models
records.caveat: Retain the memory-grounded personalized-dialogue evaluation; face verification and ASR-style component scores alone do not qualify.
records.rationale: Held-out omnimodal dialogue streams evaluate identity-linked retrieval and personalized response consistency with stored profile and social-relation facts.

records.name: CarMem
records.title: CarMem: Enhancing Long-Term Memory in LLM Voice Assistants through Category-Bounding
records.caveat: Voice-assistant motivation does not make the evaluated inputs acoustic. Retained and explicitly labeled as a text-only comparison; it is not evidence of multimodal-memory performance.
records.rationale: A synthetic text-conversation protocol directly measures preference extraction, retrieval and maintenance.

records.name: MemGUI-Bench
records.title: MemGUI-Bench: Benchmarking Memory of Mobile GUI Agents in Dynamic Environments
records.rationale: Mobile tasks measure within-session retention and reuse over repeated or mirrored interactions, with memory-fidelity evaluation.
records.caveat: Execution quality and interface perception can still affect task success.

records.name: KnowU-Bench
records.title: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
records.caveat: History-conditioned task performance is useful adjacent evidence; do not describe this benchmark as stateless.
records.rationale: Agents receive behavioral logs and can ask a user simulator for preferences; scoring targets personalized execution and proactive consent. The protocol does not separately evaluate retained memory or cross-session learning.

records.name: MementoGUI-Bench
records.title: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
records.rationale: Held-out GUI trajectories require historical constraints and subgoals, with memory-consistency scoring and an episodic bank.
records.caveat: This is a defined evaluation protocol rather than a claim that every GUI task requires memory.

records.name: Memory-World
records.title: STAMP: Training Explicit Memory for Mobile GUI Agents in Controllable and Scalable Virtual Environments
records.rationale: Transient interface information is deliberately made necessary for later actions; memory accuracy and task success are measured.
records.caveat: Oracle levels and the non-oracle task should be distinguished.

records.name: DMV-Bench
records.title: DMV-Bench: Diagnosing Long-Horizon Multimodal Agents' Visual Memory with Incidental Cue Injection
records.section: Official repository: Task family; Memory architectures audited
records.rationale: Incidental image cues observed in earlier shopping sessions must be recalled to navigate to the exact product; cues are excluded from text channels.
records.caveat: Shared encoding trajectories and read-only probes improve attribution, while navigation can still contribute errors.

records.name: DataScope
records.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
records.rationale: Cross-page and cross-app workflows require retaining targets and operation status; resulting app states verify progress and scope.
records.caveat: Synthetic data are initialized inside real applications. State-based verification scores outcomes, not agreement with an expert action sequence. Distractors are not conflicting memories, and the benchmark does not test cross-session reuse.

records.name: FindingDory
records.title: FindingDory: A Benchmark to Evaluate Memory in Embodied Agents
records.rationale: An experience-collection phase precedes questions or actions that depend on those earlier observations.
records.caveat: Controlled collection helps separate memory use from exploration quality.

records.name: 3DMem-Bench
records.title: 3DLLM-Mem: Long-Term Spatial-Temporal Memory for Embodied 3D Large Language Model
records.rationale: Embodied questions and episodic summaries use retained scene experience across observations.
records.caveat: Perception and reasoning contribute to final answers alongside memory access.

records.name: SEER-Bench
records.title: Vision to Geometry: 3D Spatial Memory for Sequential Embodied MLLM Reasoning and Exploration
records.rationale: Sequential navigation and questions evaluate reuse of scene experience over multiple goals.
records.caveat: Task success and path efficiency also depend on exploration and planning.

records.name: LMEE-Bench
records.title: Explore with Long-term Memory: A Benchmark and Multimodal LLM-based Reinforcement Learning Framework for Embodied Exploration
records.rationale: Long sequences of goals and goal-oriented questions depend on previously visited targets and accumulated progress.
records.caveat: It is an embodied memory-dependent task evaluation, not complete failure attribution.

records.name: RMBench
records.title: RMBench: Memory-Dependent Robotic Manipulation Benchmark with Insights into Policy Design
records.rationale: Manipulation tasks explicitly vary the historical information needed beyond the current observation.
records.caveat: Memory demand is controlled, but policy and action errors still affect success.

records.name: RoboMME
records.title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
records.rationale: Temporal, spatial, referential and procedural manipulation tasks require earlier observations or demonstrations.
records.caveat: Do not conflate the base benchmark with the separate interference protocol.

records.name: SpaMEM
records.title: SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments
records.rationale: The visual temporal-belief setting tests updating spatial information across observations.
records.caveat: Perception and text-oracle settings are controls, not equivalent visual-memory tests.

records.name: RoboMemArena
records.title: RoboMemArena: A Comprehensive and Challenging Robotic Memory Benchmark
records.rationale: Historically necessary subtasks are constructed so the current observation cannot supply all information needed for action.
records.caveat: Whole-task success still includes execution and reasoning.

records.name: WorldMemArena
records.title: WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction
records.rationale: Multi-session interaction tests memory formation, maintenance, retrieval and use under changing world states.
records.caveat: Simulated success and annotated memory points do not fully establish transfer to physical deployments.

records.name: eMEM-Bench v1
records.title: eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents
records.rationale: Perception-derived scene records are replayed through ingestion, delay and probing to test retention, source memory, context and interference.
records.caveat: Visual observations are converted to semantic records before memory evaluation; the protocol does not isolate raw-image encoding.

records.name: ReMemBench
records.title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
records.rationale: Household tasks require within-episode recall because immediate sensory observations omit necessary information.
records.caveat: Recall and successful action remain coupled.

records.name: WorldLines
records.title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
records.rationale: Household event traces support questions and planning over temporally changing semantic states.
records.caveat: The reviewed protocol uses semantic scene and event information; raw visual or audio inputs to the evaluated agent were not established. Retained as a stateful embodied-memory comparison.

records.name: RoboMME-Interference
records.title: RoboMME-Interference: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference
records.rationale: Relevant past demonstrations are mixed with unrelated sessions to measure retrieval and action performance under interference.
records.caveat: A distinct protocol based on RoboMME task families, not a duplicate of the base benchmark.

records.name: MEMORA-Bench
records.title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning
records.section: Sections 4.3 and 5.1; Appendices B.2-B.5 and C.3; Tables 6 and 15
records.rationale: The benchmark pairs fixed-bank recall with prospective planning; 551 information-not-available controls directly test insufficient evidence.
records.caveat: The released headline QA uses a complete fixed participant bank, without per-question temporal slicing. Timestamps support construction rather than being predicted targets. Robot execution is a demonstration, not the benchmark. Dynamic spatial/object/task tracking is not separately scored.

records.name: APRS
records.title: Seek to Segment: Active Perception for Panoramic Referring Segmentation
records.rationale: Retained cross-view spatial evidence supports active search; scored outcomes are search success, exploration efficiency and segmentation quality.
records.caveat: Static panoramas do not establish changing object states. Expert trajectories and memory timelines belong to SFT. Exploration history gives only indirect SC/TS coverage; instruction grounding gives partial CE.

records.name: SIS-Bench
records.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
records.rationale: Concatenated clips directly test landmark order/recall and spatial relations; long-video MCQs include route planning.
records.caveat: All tasks are scored by MCQ accuracy. Timestamped annotations are not predicted temporal-grounding targets. Planning selection provides indirect MA; action-sequence recall does not independently establish live task-progress tracking.

records.name: EmbodiedWorldBench
records.title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory
records.rationale: Embodied tasks evaluate an agent with memory through navigation, object search, dialogue and replanning in changing scenes.
records.caveat: The task benchmark is broader than memory diagnosis; the paper's separate memory evaluation uses other datasets.

records.name: RoboGraph benchmark
records.title: Compiling and Benchmarking Task-State Horizons for Embodied Agents
records.caveat: Restrict multimodal inclusion to the visual simulation backend; the symbolic-only backend is not multimodal.
records.rationale: Task-state horizons explicitly vary retaining observed state, exploring hidden state and updating stale state; interventions and state-management metrics diagnose memory failures.

records.name: DunphyBench
records.title: Long-Horizon Embodied Decision-Making via Multimodal Memory Compression
records.caveat: A memory-dependent decision benchmark, with outcomes also affected by preference reasoning and exploration.
records.rationale: Agents must accumulate and compare visual observations across housing environments; evaluation contrasts no-memory, text-memory and multimodal-memory configurations and varies history budget.

records.name: HIOcc
records.title: GEM-Occ: From Visual Geometry Evidence to Embodied Semantic Occupancy Memory
records.rationale: Causal map accumulation and revisit consistency directly probe persistent spatial memory.
records.caveat: Static-scene fusion is not dynamic-object tracking. Section 6 leaves changing environments and downstream navigation/manipulation to future work. Mapping progress AUC is not task-progress tracking.

records.name: MemLeak
records.title: MemLeak: Diagnosing Information Leaks in Multimodal Agent Memory
records.rationale: Requested deletion is followed by probes for recovery of the facts through retained text or images.
records.caveat: Deletion tests forgetting and cross-representation leakage; it does not by itself test contradictory facts or unanswerable-query calibration.

records.name: VideoWebArena
records.title: VideoWebArena: Evaluating Long Context Multimodal Agents with Video Understanding Web Tasks
records.rationale: Previously observed videos supply facts and skills for subsequent web tasks.
records.caveat: Video information can remain in context; task scores combine memory reuse, perception, planning and execution.

records.name: LIBERO-Mem
records.title: Rethinking Progression of Memory State in Robotic Manipulation: An Object-Centric Perspective
records.rationale: Non-Markovian manipulation tasks require object motion, relation, sequence and occlusion histories.
records.caveat: The benchmark is within visual embodied memory, without requiring an LLM-specific agent.

records.name: MIKASA-Robo (RGB+joints)
records.title: Memory, Benchmark & Robots: A Benchmark for Solving Complex Tasks with Reinforcement Learning
records.rationale: The RGB+joints setting separates observation from delayed action under occlusion or state changes.
records.caveat: Oracle-state configurations are excluded; simulation and physical extensions should not be conflated.

records.name: LoCoMo
records.title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
records.rationale: Image-sharing conversations support long-term QA, event summarization and multimodal dialogue generation, including retrieval-based memory comparisons.
records.caveat: The original QA and summarization experiments substitute captions for images; only dialogue generation uses images directly. Inclusion does not establish visually indispensable evidence in every task.

capability_corrections.reason: The reviewed v2 protocol supplies semantic household traces; complementary non-text evidence in the evaluated inputs is not established.

excluded_resources.name: MOSAIC
excluded_resources.reason: Removed at user request: full PDF unavailable; prior detailed claims were not independently verified.
